speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned having a concerning rash and recent health changes; can you describe exactly what the rash looks like, where it started, and if you have experienced any other symptoms like fever or fatigue?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced hypersensitivity syndrome (DIHS) / DRESS syndrome secondary to recent initiation of arthritis medication.

REQUEST TEST: Liver function tests, Complete Blood Count (CBC), and Eosinophil count. REQUEST IMAGES: Full body skin examination photos.
